name: Post Oak Mall
summary: Post Oak Mall is College Station's premier enclosed shopping destination featuring over 70 stores, restaurants, and specialty services. Located just off Texas Avenue, this regional mall offers everything from fashion boutiques and department stores to diverse dining options and wellness services, making it the community's favorite place to shop, dine, and socialize.
demographics: Post Oak Mall serves the College Station-Bryan metropolitan area, attracting a diverse mix of Texas A&M University students, faculty, and staff alongside local families and professionals. The primary trade area includes middle to upper-middle income households with a median age range of 25-45, reflecting the university town's younger demographic profile combined with established family residents. Shoppers typically seek a balance of value and quality, with strong preferences for both national brands and dining experiences that cater to the college lifestyle and family-friendly activities.
description: Post Oak Mall stands as College Station's premier shopping destination, conveniently located just off Texas Avenue at 1500 Harvey Road. Since opening its doors, this enclosed regional mall has served as the retail and social hub for the Bryan-College Station community, offering over 70 department stores, brand-name shops, and casual eateries under one roof. The mall features an impressive mix of fashion retailers, unique boutiques like Gold N' Diamonds, and specialty services including fitness centers and spa treatments, making it more than just a shopping center—it's a complete lifestyle destination. Dining options range from quick bites at The Wacked Out Weiner to sit-down meals at TX Chifa Street Food and Taste of the Tropics, ensuring visitors can fuel up between shopping excursions. Managed by CBL Properties, Post Oak Mall continues to evolve with exclusive deals, special events, and new tenant additions, maintaining its position as the go-to gathering place where the community comes to explore, eat, and enjoy.
